title: Original Oven Roasted Venezuelan Snow Peas Skewers
description: A cultured and crunchy Venezuelan dish featuring snow peas, this recipe is perfect for those looking for a light and flavorful meal, and is onion and garlic free.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, salt, black pepper, and paprika.
Add the snow peas to the bowl and toss to coat with the oil mixture.
Thread the snow peas onto the soaked wooden skewers, leaving a small space between each pea.
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and roast in the oven for 12 minutes.
While the snow peas are roasting, heat the rum in a small saucepan over medium heat until warm.
Remove the snow peas from the oven and brush the warm rum over the top of each skewer, being careful as the rum may flame.
Return the skewers to the oven and roast for an additional 2 minutes, or until the snow peas are tender and lightly browned.
Remove the skewers from the oven and squeeze the lime juice over the top of each skewer.
Serve the skewers hot, topped with grated cheddar cheese if desired.
